e2e.//: Real-extraction lane (docs/decisions/0009-test-lanes-unit-vs-e2e.md). Runs ONLY src/**/*.e2e.ts and src/**/*.e2e.test.ts via vitest.e2e.config.ts: the tier P suite that drives the real ts-morph extractor over real temporary source trees (ir-cache-invalidation, 24.7 s for 9 cases). The unit `test` target excludes those files. Reached by CI (`nx affected -t e2e --parallel=1`), never by the local pre-push hook; not env-gated. Cached on content (lane-reachability rule 3); declares no outputs. dependsOn mirrors `test` (the suite imports src, so only ^build).

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (packages/apigen/apigen-plugin-ir-cache/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see. The ratchet baselines the pre-existing spec errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/apigen-plugin-ir-cache.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.

test.//: Partial override — executor/cache/outputs still come from the inferred @nx/vitest target. dependsOn is replaced wholesale, so lint/^build (workspace test targetDefaults) are relisted, plus typecheck-spec so the spec corpus is gated whenever tests run (backlog 770c0919).
